Vesicle, HA & transport assumptions

HA size selects biological context; it does not prescribe efficacy. Only the explicit repair strength, coupling and CD44 channel change the repair term. All transport settings are assumed.

Exposure, retention & clearance
A unit of population probability is split between oral reservoir, tissue, blood, plaque, uptake and clearance. The single glowing vesicle follows a narrated successful route. Geometry and biological rates are uncalibrated.
LOCAL RULES → COLLECTIVE BEHAVIOR

Information is the starting state.

Available energy drives change over terrain during a defined time span. Observe the resulting system state.

Quantum → molecule → cell → tissue → organ → organism → ecosystem. Each scale has its own state, rules and evidence.

The reusable layer is local interaction, aggregation and feedback. Fish rules are a demonstration of collective coordination; biological scale couplings require their own evidence.

Neural network vs quantum-inspired challenger

MPS uses angle features and normalized squared amplitudes. Tests include global phase invariance, rank, feature ordering and a softmax ablation. Competing-fate probabilities are separate from uncertainty. Equal training steps; different computational costs.

Zero measured training cases. Microscopy remains a reference layer; image identity and HA molecular-weight effects are not learned. This model predicts its simulator, not patient outcomes.

Drag to orbit · Scroll to zoom · Separation, alignment and cohesion.
Spatial bins bound neighbor candidates to 96 per agent per step. At high density this samples interactions. Aggregate view preserves agent counts but only reduces drawing work; every agent still updates. Energy is a normalized illustrative movement budget, not joules. The terrain band reduces mobility. Controls restart the same seed for comparison. No quantum simulation, food web or calibrated ecosystem dynamics.
